description: This file defines an event listener class 'EmployeeSalaryListener' for the EmployeeSalary entity within the OrangeHRM system. It handles encryption and decryption of the salary amount during different lifecycle events such as persisting, updating, and loading entities.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryListener
classes.description: A Doctrine event listener for EmployeeSalary entity that manages encryption of salary amounts during entity lifecycle events.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts the amount when a new EmployeeSalary entity is persisted if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the amount before updating the EmployeeSalary entity if encryption is enabled and the 'amount' field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the amount after EmployeeSalary entity is updated if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the amount after EmployeeSalary entity is loaded from the database if encryption is enabled.
